definitions.explanation: The act of providing one's blood for medical use, such as transfusions. A more technical or formal alternative to the everyday word kenketsu ({献血|けんけつ}).

examples.japanese: {供血|きょうけつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{供血|きょうけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to donate blood because a family member was having surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{供血|きょうけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけ→呼びかけ：11855_yobikake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Because of a blood shortage, an urgent call for blood donations was made.

notes:
A formal term for donating blood, used primarily in medical and institutional contexts. While ⟦{献血|けんけつ}→献血：16161_kenketsu⟧ is the everyday word for voluntary blood donation at blood drives, {供血|きょうけつ} emphasizes the act of supplying blood and often appears in clinical or administrative settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {供血|きょうけつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: blood donor
- {供血|きょうけつ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of blood donated
- {供血|きょうけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive donated blood
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{供血|きょうけつ}: emergency blood donation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{献血|けんけつ}→献血：16161_kenketsu⟧: voluntary blood donation — the standard everyday term, especially for blood drives
- ⟦{輸血|ゆけつ}→輸血：04083_yuketsu⟧: blood transfusion — refers to the receiving side, not the donating side
